user.title: Add a ComfoConnect LAN C bridge
user.description: Select the ComfoConnect LAN C bridge from the list below.

manual.title: Add a ComfoConnect LAN C bridge manually
manual.description: Enter a ComfoConnect LAN C bridge hostname or IP address below.

enter_pin.title: Enter PIN
enter_pin.description: The selected ComfoConnect LAN C bridge isn't using the default PIN. Please enter the correct PIN.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the ComfoConnect LAN C bridge
reconfigure.description: Enter the new hostname or IP address of the bridge, for example after its IP address changed. Optionally enter the installer PIN of the ventilation unit to show the installer settings (leave it empty to hide them).

create_entry.default: Some sensors are not enabled by default. You can enable them in the entity registry after the integration configuration.

init.title: ComfoConnect options
init.description: Enter the installer PIN of the ventilation unit to show the installer settings (like the airflow per preset), as in the installer menu of the ComfoControl app. Leave it empty to hide them. Changing installer settings can affect how the unit ventilates your home.
